breaking.change: Runs and builds cook the selected entry's imports and asset-reference closure, plus project scenes, look, delivery-pack roots and publish.keep. Unreferenced content belonging to another entry no longer ships. Standalone og cook still prepares the authoring catalogue.
breaking.fix: Import or reference each entry's assets from that entry. Declare genuinely shared assets in project roots or publish.keep; computed og.load prefixes retain their matching assets. Rebuild each entry separately.

breaking.change: Style packs can be scene-stream members. Their private resources travel with the group; shared resources stay independent. Fallback-only fonts are selected by reached text and project languages, never preloaded just because a theme lists them. Optional faces fetch when text first needs them. The cooked UI layer format is now version 3.
breaking.fix: Re-cook with the matching runtime. Request a style's stream group before og.load.style and og.ui.configure. Declare supported languages in create.lang or import their string tables; reference a font explicitly when it must be synchronous.
